title: Wave speed calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for wave speed must be 2 m/s.

title: Total time for trough
description: Essential: The final answer for the additional time must be 3 s.

title: Period from waveform
description: Important: Correctly identifies that the 1.5 s shown corresponds to 3/4 of a period.

title: Wavelength from figure
description: Important: Correctly determines the wavelength (4 m) from the distance the wave has traveled (3 m) and the waveform shape.

title: Wave travel time
description: Important: Calculates the time for the wavefront to travel from x=3 m to x=6 m using the wave speed.

title: Particle oscillation phase
description: Important: Recognizes that once the wave reaches x=6 m, the particle there must start from zero displacement and oscillate, taking 3/4 of a period to reach its first trough.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (meters, seconds, m/s) throughout the solution.

title: Incorrect wave speed formula
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect formula (e.g., v = fλ) with wrong f or λ, or misinterprets the graph to get v.

title: Phase or travel time error
description: Pitfall: Omits either the wave travel time to x=6 m or the 3/4 period oscillation time, or adds them incorrectly.
